messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: shinyapps.io is now generally available
parts:
We are happy to announce that with your help, shinyapps.io is now out of beta and commercially available to everyone.  For the beta participants, you should have all received a thank you gift, in the form of a discount coupon in your inbox.  Please let us know if you haven't and we would be happy to resend it.

We truly appreciate all the suggestions and improvements that you helped drive, and are excited to tackle the next batch of work that you have requested. 

Looking forward to the next phase of our journey together.

The shinyapps.io team
